name: Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad
summary: Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad engages in refining, manufacturing, and selling petroleum products in Malaysia. It offers liquefied petroleum gas; petrol; jet fuel; diesel; fuel oil components; sulphur; light naphtha; and propylene. The company was formerly known as Shell Refining Company (Federation of Malaya) Berhad and changed its name to Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad in March 2017. Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The company operates as a subsidiary of Malaysia Hengyuan International Limited.
